entries.name: Treecko
entries.rationale: Spe 70 on a height 5 gecko gives quick feet and the baseline DRI 76 and ACC 76 already reflect it; weight 50 and def 35 leave it easy to knock off the ball.

entries.name: Grovyle
entries.rationale: Spe 95 and an upright shape with kickMoves like double-kick and low-sweep make it a natural wide runner; def 45 and weight 216 keep it out of defensive roles.

entries.name: Sceptile
entries.rationale: Spe 120 with atk 85 and spa 105 on an upright height 17 frame produce an elite wide forward; def 65 is the soft spot, and the baseline already carries the attacking ceiling.

entries.name: Torchic
entries.rationale: Height 4 and weight 25 with legs shape give it little to hold off defenders; ability Speed Boost and early kickMoves already lift its pace and shooting in Layer 1.

entries.name: Combusken
entries.rationale: Fire/fighting type with blaze-kick and double-kick in kickMoves already earns large SHO and TEC mods; spe 55 keeps it a central creator rather than a wide runner.

entries.name: Blaziken
entries.rationale: Genus Blaze and kickMoves blaze-kick and high-jump-kick make it the franchise kicker, and the baseline SHO 99 and KIC 99 already say so; def 70 is the only gap.

entries.name: Mudkip
entries.rationale: Quadruped shape at height 4 with spe 40 makes it a short-range grafter; atk 70 and the even hp/def/spd line suit a holding role more than its W role blend suggests.

entries.name: Marshtomp
entries.rationale: Water/ground type on an upright frame with hp 70, atk 85, def 70 and spe 50 reads as a sturdy holding midfielder; the baseline already balances it.

entries.name: Swampert
entries.rationale: Weight 819 and height 15 with hp 100 and atk 110 make it a powerful anchor; spe 60 and ACC 48 rule out wide work, and its upright shape with big arms keeps GK viable.

entries.name: Poochyena
entries.rationale: Genus Bite and ability Quick Feet give it a snapping, chasing style; spa 30 and quadruped shape leave little passing range, and Layer 1 already added its pace.

entries.name: Mightyena
entries.rationale: Ability Intimidate and atk 90 on a quadruped hunter make it a pressing forward; spa 60 and the quadruped shape keep its passing ordinary.

entries.name: Zigzagoon
entries.rationale: Spe 60 and quadruped shape at height 4 give a darting runner; atk 30 and spa 30 leave almost no end product, which the baseline already shows.

entries.name: Linoone
entries.rationale: Genus Rushing with spe 100 marks a straight-line sprinter, so pace edges up; a quadruped that runs in straight lines turns poorly, so DRI 90 is trimmed.

entries.name: Wurmple
entries.rationale: Height 3 armor-shaped larva with spe 20 and spa 20 has nothing to offer going forward; def and physicality are its least bad attributes.

entries.name: Silcoon
entries.rationale: Genus Cocoon with ball shape and spe 15 is close to immobile, so ACC 30 takes a small trim for a body that cannot move; def 55 is the only thing it brings.

entries.name: Beautifly
entries.rationale: Bug-wings shape and spa 100 support an airborne creator, while weight 284 and def 50 already keep it out of contact duels.

entries.name: Cascoon
entries.rationale: Ball-shaped cocoon at height 7 with spe 15 barely moves, so ACC 29 takes a small trim for a body that cannot move; def 55 is its only usable trait.

entries.name: Dustox
entries.rationale: Spd 90 and def 70 make it a sturdy moth, and bug-wings shape already lifts its AER; atk 50 with no kicking limbs keeps it away from scoring roles despite its GK role blend.

entries.name: Lotad
entries.rationale: Armor shape at height 5 with base stats all 50 or below limits it everywhere; its lily-pad body gives balance but no threat, so the baseline stands and it holds a deep position.

entries.name: Lombre
entries.rationale: Genus Jolly with ability Own Tempo on a humanoid frame suits a playful link player; spe 50 and atk 50 keep it short of a forward role.

entries.name: Ludicolo
entries.rationale: Genus Carefree and its well-known dancing design add rhythm on the ball, so dribbling rises a little; spd 100 and spa 90 support a deep playmaker while spe 70 limits wide play.

entries.name: Seedot
entries.rationale: Legs shape acorn at height 5 with def 50 and spe 30 is a small, tough blocker with no creative range.

entries.name: Nuzleaf
entries.rationale: Genus Wily and ability Pickpocket point to a sly attacker; def 40 and spd 40 make it fragile in defence.

entries.name: Shiftry
entries.rationale: Genus Wicked with atk 100 and spa 90 and kickMoves low-kick and low-sweep give a forceful attacker; def 60 and spd 60 keep it out of the back line.

entries.name: Taillow
entries.rationale: Height 3 swallow with spe 85 and ability Guts is a bold flier; weight 23 gives no physical presence, which the baseline already shows.

entries.name: Swellow
entries.rationale: Spe 125 and wings shape make it one of the fastest wide threats; def 60 and weight 198 keep it light in duels.

entries.name: Wingull
entries.rationale: Spe 85 and wings shape give quick flank coverage; atk 30 and weight 95 offer little power.

entries.name: Pelipper
entries.rationale: Genus Water Bird with its famous scooping bill and def 100 suit a shot-stopper, so handling recovers a little of what the wings shape removed; spe 65 limits it upfield.

entries.name: Ralts
entries.rationale: Height 4 with hp 28 and def 25 is the frailest of its line; psychic/fairy type and spa 45 give a little vision but nothing physical.

entries.name: Kirlia
entries.rationale: Genus Emotion with spa 65 and a dancer's humanoid build suits a light playmaker; def 35 and hp 38 rule out defensive work.

entries.name: Gardevoir
entries.rationale: Spa 125 and spd 115 on a humanoid height 16 frame produce an elite playmaker with PAS 99 and VIS 98; atk 65 and def 65 keep it out of contact roles.

entries.name: Surskit
entries.rationale: Genus Pond Skater with weight 17 and spe 65 glides quickly but has no mass; atk 30 means no shot.

entries.name: Masquerain
entries.rationale: Spa 100 and bug-wings shape make it an airborne creator, and ability Intimidate fits its eyeball wings; weight 36 already keeps its tackling low.

entries.name: Shroomish
entries.rationale: Legs shape mushroom at height 4 with hp 60 and def 60 is a sturdy small blocker; spe 35 and atk 40 give no attacking threat.

entries.name: Breloom
entries.rationale: Atk 130 with ability Technician and fighting type punches above its height 12; hp 60 and spa 60 leave it short on stamina and vision.

entries.name: Slakoth
entries.rationale: Genus Slacker with ability Truant and spe 30 does as little as possible; Layer 1 already cut stamina, and the baseline pace is already low.

entries.name: Vigoroth
entries.rationale: Genus Wild Monkey with ability Vital Spirit and spe 90 is a restless engine, so stamina rises a touch; that same frenzy costs composure.

entries.name: Slaking
entries.rationale: Genus Lazy and ability Truant mean it acts every other turn, so spe 100 overstates how fast it actually gets anywhere; atk 160 and weight 1305 still make it a devastating static presence.

entries.name: Nincada
entries.rationale: Def 90 on an armor-shaped height 5 burrower makes it a tough little blocker; spa 30 and spe 40 give nothing going forward.

entries.name: Ninjask
entries.rationale: Spe 160 with ability Speed Boost already maxes PAC and ACC; weight 120 bug-wings shape has tiny legs, so KIC 62 is trimmed.

entries.name: Shedinja
entries.rationale: Hp 1 and weight 12 make it a hollow shell, which the baseline already prices; ability Wonder Guard makes it a strange static blocker rather than a runner.

entries.name: Whismur
entries.rationale: Upright shape at height 6 with hp 64 but def 23 and spe 28 gives a slow, fragile midfielder; ability Soundproof offers nothing on the ball.

entries.name: Loudred
entries.rationale: Genus Big Voice with hp 84 and atk 71 is a loud presence in midfield; spe 48 keeps it central.

entries.name: Exploud
entries.rationale: Genus Loud Noise with hp 104 and weight 840 makes a commanding midfield body; spe 68 and ACC 56 limit its range.

entries.name: Makuhita
entries.rationale: Genus Guts with ability Thick Fat and a sumo build at weight 864 is a low, heavy pusher; spe 25 rules out running roles.

entries.name: Hariyama
entries.rationale: Genus Arm Thrust with hp 144 and weight 2538 is a sumo wall; Layer 1 already rewarded its kickMoves and arms, and spe 50 keeps it central.

entries.name: Azurill
entries.rationale: IsBaby with height 2 and atk 20 has no physical game; its bouncing tail suits a tiny wide role at best.

entries.name: Nosepass
entries.rationale: Def 135 and weight 970 make it an immovable rock, but its stubby humanoid arms do not earn HAN 85; it plays as a wall in front of goal, not in it.

entries.name: Skitty
entries.rationale: Genus Kitten with spe 50 and quadruped shape is a playful, darting runner; atk 45 gives little end product.

entries.name: Delcatty
entries.rationale: Spe 90 on a quadruped cat gives real flank pace; genus Prim suggests a reluctant worker, and atk 65 limits its shot.

entries.name: Sableye
entries.rationale: Ability Prankster and genus Darkness suit a sneaky creator, and Layer 1 already rewarded its kickMoves; height 5 and spe 50 limit its pace and presence, so it works centrally.

entries.name: Mawile
entries.rationale: Genus Deceiver with ability Intimidate and atk 85 uses its steel jaw to bite into tackles; spe 50 and height 6 keep it compact.

entries.name: Aron
entries.rationale: Def 100 and weight 600 on a height 4 steel body make it a dense little stopper; spe 30 and spa 40 limit everything else.

entries.name: Lairon
entries.rationale: Def 140 and weight 1200 on a quadruped steel frame give a charging defender; spe 40 rules out wide work.

entries.name: Aggron
entries.rationale: Def 180, weight 3600 and height 21 make it a towering steel centre-back with ability Rock Head; Layer 1 already cut ACC for its mass.

entries.name: Meditite
entries.rationale: Genus Meditate with fighting/psychic type and kickMoves high-jump-kick gives a calm technical striker; hp 30 and height 6 make it fragile.

entries.name: Medicham
entries.rationale: Eleven kickMoves including axe-kick and high-jump-kick plus ability Pure Power make it a kicking specialist, already reflected in SHO and KIC mods; def 75 and hp 60 keep it out of defence.

entries.name: Electrike
entries.rationale: Spe 65 on a quadruped electric dog gives quick bursts; atk 45 and weight 152 limit its contact game.

entries.name: Manectric
entries.rationale: Spe 105 and spa 105 on a quadruped frame make it a fast wide forward; def 60 keeps it out of the back line.

entries.name: Plusle
entries.rationale: Genus Cheering and ability Plus point to a support player built for a partner, and spe 95 gives burst; height 4 and def 40 rule out defending.

entries.name: Minun
entries.rationale: Genus Cheering with ability Minus and spe 95 suits a wide support runner; atk 40 and height 4 give no shot.

entries.name: Volbeat
entries.rationale: Spe 85 and an upright firefly frame make a quick wide runner, and ability Prankster suits a cheeky style; atk 73 and weight 177 give modest power.

entries.name: Illumise
entries.rationale: Spa 73 and spd 85 with ability Tinted Lens suit a wide creator who leads others; atk 47 limits its shooting.

entries.name: Roselia
entries.rationale: Spa 100 and spd 80 give PAS 86, while height 3 and weight 20 leave it with no physical presence.

entries.name: Gulpin
entries.rationale: Genus Stomach with arms shape and hp 70 already gets large HAN mods from Layer 1; spe 40 and atk 43 keep it out of the attack.

entries.name: Swalot
entries.rationale: Genus Poison Bag with hp 100, weight 800 and a mouth that swallows whole is a natural keeper, already HAN 95; spe 55 rules out wide roles.

entries.name: Carvanha
entries.rationale: Genus Savage with atk 90 makes it an aggressive finisher; def 20 and the fish shape penalties leave it fragile and slow off the mark.

entries.name: Sharpedo
entries.rationale: Genus Brutal with atk 120 and ability Rough Skin gives a menacing forward; def 40 and spd 40 and the fish shape keep it fragile.

entries.name: Wailmer
entries.rationale: Genus Ball Whale with hp 130 and weight 1300 fills space; fish shape and spe 60 already cut its mobility.

entries.name: Wailord
entries.rationale: Height 145 and weight 3980 make it the largest body on any pitch, so it blocks the goal and the box by sheer size; hp 170 backs it, and the fish shape already removed its mobility.

entries.name: Numel
entries.rationale: Genus Numb with ability Oblivious and spe 35 is slow to react; hp 60 and a quadruped frame give modest holding value.

entries.name: Camerupt
entries.rationale: Atk 100 and spa 105 on a weight 2200 quadruped give real power; spe 40 rules out any wide role.

entries.name: Torkoal
entries.rationale: Def 140 on a weight 804 tortoise shell makes it a hard blocker; spe 20 is among the slowest anywhere.

entries.name: Spoink
entries.rationale: Genus Bounce and its spring-tail design make it a constant jumper, so aerial ability rises; spa 70 and spd 80 support vision while atk 25 gives no shot.

entries.name: Grumpig
entries.rationale: Spd 110 and spa 90 with genus Manipulate suit a deep playmaker; atk 45 keeps it from scoring.

entries.name: Spinda
entries.rationale: Ability Tangled Feet and its well-known tottering design make its movement hard to read but its touch erratic, so passing and technique drop; base stats all 60 otherwise keep it average.

entries.name: Trapinch
entries.rationale: Genus Ant Pit with atk 100 and ability Hyper Cutter clamps down with huge jaws, so tackling rises; spe 10 means it barely moves.

entries.name: Vibrava
entries.rationale: Spe 70 and bug-wings shape give it mobility, already credited in AER; def 50 and weight 153 keep it light.

entries.name: Flygon
entries.rationale: Spe 100 and atk 100 with wings shape make a fast aerial forward; its balanced 80s across def and spd add cover, but wings limit close control.

entries.name: Cacnea
entries.rationale: Atk 85 and spa 85 on a humanoid cactus give a punchy creator; spe 35 and def 40 limit its mobility and durability.

entries.name: Cacturne
entries.rationale: Genus Scarecrow with atk 115 and spa 115 stands and strikes; spe 55 keeps it central rather than wide.

entries.name: Swablu
entries.rationale: Weight 12 and wings shape make a light flier with spd 75; atk 40 gives no shot.

entries.name: Altaria
entries.rationale: Def 90 and spd 105 with dragon/flying type and ability Natural Cure suit a calm aerial defender; atk 70 keeps it out of scoring roles.

entries.name: Zangoose
entries.rationale: Atk 115 and spe 90 with kickMoves double-kick give a fierce claw-led attacker; def 60 and its combative genus Cat Ferret cost discipline.

entries.name: Seviper
entries.rationale: Squiggle shape with no legs cannot leap, so AER 89 overstates it despite height 27; atk 100 and its bladed tail make it an aggressive presence.

entries.name: Lunatone
entries.rationale: Ball shape with ability Levitate and spa 95 gives an orbiting holder with vision; no limbs, so Layer 1 already cut its ball skills.

entries.name: Solrock
entries.rationale: Atk 95 and def 85 on a weight 1540 ball-shaped rock make a heavy blocker; no limbs limits its touch.

entries.name: Barboach
entries.rationale: Height 4 and weight 19 fish with spe 60 is slippery but tiny; atk 48 gives no threat.

entries.name: Whiscash
entries.rationale: Hp 110 and ability Anticipation make it a steady holder; fish shape and spe 60 already took its mobility.

entries.name: Corphish
entries.rationale: Genus Ruffian with atk 80 and ability Hyper Cutter grabs with its pincers, so tackling rises; spe 35 and spa 50 keep it simple.

entries.name: Crawdaunt
entries.rationale: Genus Rogue with atk 120 and big claws makes an aggressive striker or stopper; spe 55 and armor shape keep it off the flanks.

entries.name: Baltoy
entries.rationale: Arms shape with ability Levitate and spd 70 suits a reactive keeper; atk 40 and height 5 give no punch.

entries.name: Claydol
entries.rationale: Spd 120 and def 105 on an arms-shaped levitating body give HAN 96 and GKP 91; it has no legs, so dribbling and kicking stay weak.

entries.name: Lileep
entries.rationale: Blob shape sea lily with spe 23 is anchored in place; spd 87 and def 77 give holding value.

entries.name: Cradily
entries.rationale: Genus Barnacle with ability Suction Cups and grabbing tentacles holds onto the ball better than its blob shape suggests, so handling recovers a little; spe 43 rules out running.

entries.name: Anorith
entries.rationale: Spe 75 and atk 95 with claws make an aggressive runner; spa 40 gives little vision.

entries.name: Armaldo
entries.rationale: Genus Plate with atk 125 and def 100 and ability Battle Armor make a heavy armored stopper; spe 45 limits its range.

entries.name: Feebas
entries.rationale: Atk 15 and spa 10 make it the weakest attacker in the generation; spe 80 is its only asset, and fish shape already cut its mobility.

entries.name: Milotic
entries.rationale: Spd 125 and height 62 give a long body that covers the goal, so its squiggle shape still suits GK; no limbs, already reflected in Layer 1 cuts.

entries.name: Castform
entries.rationale: Weight 8 and height 3 make it a tiny cloud, already reflected in its physicality. Ball shape with no feet already costs it DRI 22 in Layer 1, so DRI 61 needs no further trim, while spe 70 keeps it lively.

entries.name: Kecleon
entries.rationale: Ability Color Change and its camouflage design suit a hidden holding player; spd 120 and def 70 add sturdiness while spe 40 limits pace.

entries.name: Shuppet
entries.rationale: Weight 23 ghost with atk 75 and ball shape flits around; def 35 and spd 33 make it fragile.

entries.name: Banette
entries.rationale: Genus Marionette with atk 115 and ghost type strikes unexpectedly; def 65 and weight 125 keep it light.

entries.name: Duskull
entries.rationale: Def 90 and spd 90 with ability Levitate and arms shape suit a keeper; spe 25 and atk 40 rule out attacking roles.

entries.name: Dusclops
entries.rationale: Def 130 and spd 130 with genus Beckon and large hands make an imposing keeper, already HAN 88; spe 25 is very slow.

entries.name: Tropius
entries.rationale: Height 20 with a long neck and hp 99 makes it a strong aerial defender; quadruped shape and spe 51 cut its mobility.

entries.name: Chimecho
entries.rationale: Its wind chime body has only tiny nubs, so the arms-shape handling bonus overshoots; weight 10 already keeps it out of contact, and spa 95 and spd 90 make it a light creator.

entries.name: Absol
entries.rationale: Atk 130 with ability Super Luck and a blade horn make it a cutting forward; def 60 and hp 65 keep it fragile.

entries.name: Wynaut
entries.rationale: IsBaby with hp 95 and ability Shadow Tag holds its ground; atk 23 and spe 23 give nothing going forward.

entries.name: Snorunt
entries.rationale: Base stats all 50 on a height 7 humanoid give an average young winger; ability Inner Focus adds calm but no power.

entries.name: Glalie
entries.rationale: Ball shape with weight 2565 and stats all 80 make a heavy floating blocker; no limbs, so Layer 1 already cut its ball skills.

entries.name: Spheal
entries.rationale: Fish shape seal with spe 25 and weight 395 is round and slow; hp 70 and ability Thick Fat make it hard to move.

entries.name: Sealeo
entries.rationale: Genus Ball Roll and its well-known ball-balancing design earn back some touch and heading that the fish shape removed; spe 45 keeps it slow.

entries.name: Walrein
entries.rationale: Hp 110 and weight 1506 on a quadruped walrus with tusks make a sturdy anchor; spe 65 and ACC 52 limit its range.

entries.name: Clamperl
entries.rationale: Genus Bivalve with ball shape and def 85 is a closed shell; no limbs and spe 32 keep it static.

entries.name: Huntail
entries.rationale: Atk 104 and def 105 on a squiggle-shaped eel make a biting stopper; no limbs, already cut by Layer 1.

entries.name: Gorebyss
entries.rationale: Spa 114 and def 105 on a slender squiggle body suit a deep passer; spe 52 and no limbs limit its ball carrying.

entries.name: Relicanth
entries.rationale: Def 130 with ability Rock Head and kickMoves head-smash make a hard-headed blocker; fish shape and spe 55 cut its mobility.

entries.name: Luvdisc
entries.rationale: Spe 97 on a weight 87 heart-shaped fish gives quick reactions; atk 30 and fish shape leave no power.

entries.name: Bagon
entries.rationale: Genus Rock Head with ability Rock Head and its signature headbutting design earns better heading; spa 40 and spd 30 give little vision.

entries.name: Shelgon
entries.rationale: Genus Endurance with def 100 and weight 1105 is a shelled blocker; spe 50 on a quadruped shell rules out wide roles.

entries.name: Salamence
entries.rationale: Atk 135, spe 100 and ability Intimidate with dragon/flying type make a ferocious aerial forward; quadruped shape limits close control.

entries.name: Beldum
entries.rationale: Blob shape with weight 952 and def 80 is a heavy magnetic block; spe 30 and no legs give no mobility.

entries.name: Metang
entries.rationale: Arms shape with weight 2025 and def 100 give a strong blocker with HAN 83; spe 50 limits range.

entries.name: Metagross
entries.rationale: Atk 135 and def 130 with weight 5500 make a dominant centre-back; heads shape on four legs and spe 70 limit its turn and dribble.

entries.name: Regirock
entries.rationale: Def 200 and weight 2300 on a humanoid rock body make an immovable stopper; spe 50 keeps it central.

entries.name: Regice
entries.rationale: Spd 200 and spa 100 make a calm, reading holder; spe 50 and atk 50 limit its attacking value.

entries.name: Registeel
entries.rationale: Def 150 and spd 150 on a steel humanoid make a balanced wall; spe 50 limits its range.

entries.name: Latias
entries.rationale: Spd 130 and spe 110 with ability Levitate and wings shape make a fast, intelligent wide player; atk 80 keeps it a provider rather than a finisher.

entries.name: Latios
entries.rationale: Spa 130 and spe 110 with wings shape make an attacking creator with range; def 80 keeps it out of defence.

entries.name: Kyogre
entries.rationale: Height 45 and weight 3520 with spa 150 and spd 140 make a huge commanding presence; fish shape already took its mobility.

entries.name: Groudon
entries.rationale: Atk 150, def 140 and weight 9500 on an upright frame make an overpowering presence; Layer 1 already cut ACC for its mass.

entries.name: Rayquaza
entries.rationale: Atk 150 and spa 150 with dragon/flying type and height 70 make a dominant aerial force; squiggle shape with tiny limbs already cut its touch.

entries.name: Jirachi
entries.rationale: Weight 11 already holds PHY at 63 and TAK at 69, so those stand, but height 3 gives no reach to handle a shot, so HAN drops; base stats all 100 still make it a gifted creator.

entries.name: Deoxys
entries.rationale: Atk 150, spa 150 and spe 150 with tentacle arms make an explosive forward; def 50 and spd 50 make it fragile.
